evaluation.official: Three complete official source extents; long0163/0059 six-second source excerpts have no full official clip score. This is developmental Native-first exploration.
evaluation.adaptation: Exact actual rational PTS to24fps nearest; target times strictly within source half-open extent. Four subject/object cases and one style extension reported separately.
evaluation.visibility_policy: Reference event review plan is evaluation-only. No manually labelled event window enters attention or prompting.
